title: FDA approves levacetylleucine for ataxia-telangiectasia | ACNR
summary:
The US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved levacetylleucine (Aqneursa, IntraBio) for the treatment of ataxia in adults and children with ataxia-telangiectasia (A-T) weighing at least 15 kg.
